identity.name: Aadarsha KC
bio: I'm a second-year Cybersecurity student obsessed with breaking things ethically — then building them stronger. My playground is the intersection of network defence, exploit development, and CTF competition.
When I'm not studying packets or reverse-engineering binaries, I'm contributing to open-source security tools and documenting my CTF write-ups for the community.
identity.heroSub: BSc Cybersecurity · Ethical Hacking · Network Defence

projects.title: Network Packet Analyser
projects.description: A real-time Python tool for deep packet inspection and traffic visualisation on local networks. Exports to PCAP and generates summary threat reports.
projects.longDescription: Built during Level 4 security practices module. Captures live network traffic using Scapy, performs deep packet inspection, correlates with threat intelligence databases, and exports findings as PCAP files for forensic analysis. Includes a SQLite backend for storing historical traffic patterns and generates automated threat risk assessments.

projects.title: CTF Write-up Archive
projects.description: Documented solutions and methodology breakdowns for 25+ CTF competitions across HackTheBox, TryHackMe, and PicoCTF. Organised by category and difficulty.
projects.longDescription: Comprehensive repository of CTF writeups with detailed walkthroughs, scripts, and methodology notes. Covers web exploitation, reverse engineering, cryptography, forensics, and OSINT challenges. Each writeup includes the challenge overview, reconnaissance process, exploitation techniques, and lessons learned. Updated regularly with new challenges solved.

projects.title: Auto Vulnerability Scanner
projects.description: Automated multi-threaded scanner that runs Nmap, checks CVE databases, and generates PDF vulnerability reports for small business network audits.
projects.longDescription: Enterprise-grade vulnerability scanner designed for penetration testing engagements. Automates Nmap reconnaissance, cross-references discovered services with CVE databases, performs banner grabbing, and compiles findings into professional PDF reports with remediation recommendations.

projects.title: E2E Encrypted Chat
projects.description: Peer-to-peer encrypted messaging application using RSA for key exchange and AES-256-GCM for message encryption. No server stores message content.
projects.longDescription: Cryptography deep-dive project implementing end-to-end encryption from scratch. Uses RSA-2048 for secure key exchange and AES-256-GCM for authenticated encryption. Built as a desktop application with Tkinter for the GUI. Demonstrates practical application of cryptographic principles in secure communication systems.
